unit: Geometry · Chapter 4. Sides and angles of a triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: If all angles are acute the triangle is acute; with a right angle it is right; with an obtuse angle it is obtuse.
stages.headlineEnglish: If all angles are acute the triangle is acute; with a right angle it is right; with an obtuse angle it is obtuse.

stages.headline: In a right triangle the side opposite the right angle is the hypotenuse; the other two are legs.
stages.headlineEnglish: In a right triangle the side opposite the right angle is the hypotenuse; the other two are legs.

stages.headline: Since the angles sum to 180°, a triangle has at most one right or obtuse angle; the acute angles of a right triangle sum to 90°.
stages.headlineEnglish: Since the angles sum to 180°, a triangle has at most one right or obtuse angle; the acute angles of a right triangle sum to 90°.
